_comment: LeadBot v2 — Optimized config. All performance/safety knobs in one place.

_tuning_guide.verification_workers: 6 = default sweet spot. 8-10 = faster but more aggressive. Max 12 (hard cap). NEVER increase OSM workers.
_tuning_guide.delay_seconds: 2 = minimum safe. 3 = conservative. 1 = risky for shared sites.
_tuning_guide.requests_per_minute: 120 = safe for most sites. 60 = very conservative. Never >200.
_tuning_guide.rate_limit_safety_ratio: 0.85 = use 85% of RPM budget. Lower = more headroom.
_tuning_guide.max_tile_area_deg2: 0.35 = city-sized tiles. 0.5 = larger. Smaller = more tiles but safer Overpass queries.
_tuning_guide.website_cache_ttl_seconds: 604800 = 7 days. Same website won't be re-fetched for 7 days = huge speed boost on repeat runs.
_tuning_guide.storage_batch_size: 20 = save every 20 leads. Lower = safer on crash. Higher = fewer Sheets API calls.
